text: Tell me about the conversation in the parking lot.
I mean, it was kind of just a normal talk, I guess.
Stuff about work, probably. I don't remember the exact words.
Not long. A few minutes. Or maybe longer. I'm not sure.
They did, I think. Or I did. It sort of just happened.
There might have been people around. Parking lots are busy.
Did you discuss the missing laptop?
We may have touched on office things. I wouldn't say it was about that specifically.
What happened when the conversation ended?
I went to my car, more or less, and left.
